description: Large tropical plant with split leaves. Likes bright indirect light and humid air.
wateringNotes: Let the top 2-3 cm of soil dry out between waterings.

description: Easy trailing vine that tolerates low light and irregular care.
wateringNotes: Water when the soil is dry to the first knuckle.

description: Hardy succulent with upright striped leaves. Very drought tolerant.
wateringNotes: Overwatering is the main risk. Let the soil dry out completely.

description: Desert plant that needs strong sun and very little water.
wateringNotes: Water thoroughly only when soil is completely dry. Less in winter.

description: Succulent with thick gel-filled leaves. Likes bright sun.
wateringNotes: Soak the soil and let it dry fully before watering again.

description: Fast-growing herb for kitchen windowsills. Needs lots of sun.
wateringNotes: Keep the soil evenly moist. Avoid watering the leaves.

description: Vigorous herb with a strong aroma. Spreads quickly, so keep it in a pot.
Flowering plant with dark green leaves. Shows drooping when thirsty.
wateringNotes: Water when the top few cm of soil are dry. It droops when it needs water.

description: Feathery fern that loves humidity. Sensitive to dry air.
wateringNotes: Keep the soil moist but not soggy.

description: Fragrant Mediterranean herb. Needs full sun and good drainage.
wateringNotes: Allow the soil to dry between waterings. Overwatering causes root rot.

description: Fruiting plant for sunny windowsills. Needs warmth and strong light.
wateringNotes: Water deeply and regularly to avoid blossom end rot.

description: Compact pepper plant that produces small hot fruit indoors with enough light.
wateringNotes: Keep the soil lightly moist. Let the top layer dry slightly between waterings.

description: Arching plant with striped leaves and plantlets. Good for beginners.
wateringNotes: Water when the top of the soil feels dry. Brown tips mean too much fluoride or dry air.
